title: Fragmented service operations
body: Multi-vendor estates with no shared process spine. I design SIAM and ITIL operating models that hold across suppliers, with governance, audit and KPI reporting baked in.

title: Stalled digital transformation
body: Platforms bought but not adopted. I run maturity assessments, gap analysis and roadmaps with target KPIs so investment converts into measurable outcomes.

title: AI with no business case
body: Agentic and conversational AI pitched as novelty. I frame it against real deflection, cycle-time and experience metrics using LangGraph-based patterns.

title: Deals that don't close
body: Technical wins without commercial traction. I apply value-based selling and MEDDIC to build champions, quantify value and drive ACV growth.
